problem: Fillet blend larger than neighbouring faces or end face parallel
workaround: Larger fillets first; reduce the one that cannot fit; or model as a sketched profile body, intersect, combine.

problem: Join failed on coincident side faces
Trim cut skipped silently on coincident arc faces
workaround: Oversized intersect profile and a separate body.

problem: Intersect changed only the first target
workaround: Run intersect again for each target.

problem: solid.thread rejected inch UNC strings such as 3/8-16 UNC
workaround: ISO metric only; leave inch threads unmodelled and use tap-drill diameters.
